description: The agent must read SKILL.md and chain three tool calls correctly: (1) Call `get_stock_price` with `ticker='NVDA'`, `timeframe='1wk'` (MUST use the exact '1wk' string, not 'weekly' or 'week'), `period1='2024-01-01'`, `period2='2024-03-31'` — the proprietary trap is that only '1d', '1wk', '1mo' are valid timeframe values. (2) Call `get_crypto_price` with `token='ethereum'` (MUST use full lowercase token name, NOT the ticker 'ETH' — the server will reject ticker-style inputs) and `currency='eur'`. (3) Call `fetch_economic_calendar` with `importance='High'` (MUST use exact Title Case — 'High', not 'high' or 'HIGH') and `currencies='USD'`. The agent must then synthesize all three API responses into a single `morning_briefing.json` file containing NVDA weekly OHLCV records, ETH price in EUR, and a list of USD High-impact economic events.
